decor.name: well
decor.title: Old stone well
decor.say: An old stone well. Locals say if you shout a ticker into it, it echoes back louder.
decor.prompt: an old round stone well with a little wooden roof, a rope and a wooden bucket

decor.name: windmill
decor.title: Windmill
decor.say: The windmill grinds grain by day and powers the Scout Station's chargers by night.
decor.prompt: a tall wooden windmill with a stone base, a small door at the bottom centre and four big cloth sails
